command: cd /work/crate && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f && git status --short && for f in /work/AGENTS.md /work/crate/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done

cd /work/crate && for f in /AGENTS.md /work/AGENTS.md Cargo.toml alpha/Cargo.toml beta/Cargo.toml alpha/src/lib.rs beta/src/lib.rs; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '\n%s\n' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done && find /work -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md -o -name CONTRIBUTING.md -o -name rustfmt.toml -o -name .rustfmt.toml -o -name clippy.toml -o -name rust-toolchain.toml -o -name rust-toolchain \) -print

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo metadata --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 > /work/crate-metadata-before.json && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/work/crate')
p = root / 'Cargo.toml'
p.write_text(p.read_text() + '\n[workspace.package]\nedition = "2021"\nlicense = "MIT"\n\n[workspace.lints.rust]\nunsafe_code = "forbid"\n')
for member in ('alpha', 'beta'):
    p = root / member / 'Cargo.toml'
    text = p.read_text()
    text = text.replace('edition = "2021"\nlicense = "MIT"', 'edition.workspace = true\nlicense.workspace = true')
    text = text.replace('[lints.rust]\nunsafe_code = "forbid"', '[lints]\nworkspace = true')
    p.write_text(text)
PY
RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bash /work/.agents/skills/rust-qc/scripts/check.sh /work/crate

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo metadata --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 > /work/crate-metadata-after.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
before = json.loads(Path('/work/crate-metadata-before.json').read_text())
after = json.loads(Path('/work/crate-metadata-after.json').read_text())
assert before == after, 'Cargo metadata changed'
root = Path('/work/crate')
for member, version in [('alpha', '0.1.0'), ('beta', '0.2.0')]:
    assert (root / member / 'src/lib.rs').read_text() == f'//! The {member} library.\n'
    package = next(p for p in after['packages'] if p['name'] == member)
    assert (package['version'], package['edition'], package['license']) == (version, '2021', 'MIT')
print('Cargo metadata unchanged; member names, versions, edition, license, and sources preserved.')
lock = root / 'Cargo.lock'
if lock.exists():
    lock.unlink()
for path in ['/work/crate-metadata-before.json', '/work/crate-metadata-after.json']:
    Path(path).unlink()
for path in [root / 'Cargo.toml', root / 'alpha/Cargo.toml', root / 'beta/Cargo.toml']:
    print(f'\n{path}\n{path.read_text()}', end='')
PY
